answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. Each submission hangs on the quill of a task receipt, and the beacon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The ivory of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
